guitar.notes: Tony Iommi's Gibson SG (and later custom Jaydee SG-shaped guitar) is iconic and extremely well documented.

tone.target: dark Sabbath crunch with woolly fuzz edge
tone.profile: dark Sabbath crunch with woolly fuzz edge
tone.summary: A gritty, high-gain chain utilizing a Fuzz/Distortion combination into a British Plexi-style amp model with a 4x12 cabinet to achieve the characteristic Sabbath crunch.
corrections: swap mid-scooped for dark mid-forward fuzz crunch
keep it gritty, not overdriven clean

rig.name: Black Sabbath - Sabbath Bloody Sabbath - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and excessive noise inherent in high-gain fuzz tones.
Provide initial grit and mid-range punch to complement the fuzz stage.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used here as a foundational boost/grit source, mimicking early tube saturation before the main distortion. A dedicated Boost might be better, but this provides necessary tone shaping.

blocks.purpose: Generate the required woolly fuzz edge and thick sustain characteristic of early Sabbath.
Simulate the Plexi-style British amplification needed for classic heavy rock weight and dark mids.
Provide the classic British cabinet sound and necessary weight for heavy riffs.
Darken the overall tone and emphasize dark mids while controlling excessive high-end brightness.
blocks.gap: The EQ is used to manually sculpt the 'dark mid-forward' sound, compensating for potential inherent brightness in the fuzz/amp chain.

blocks.purpose: Disabled. Chorus is explicitly avoided to maintain a raw, aggressive tone.
blocks.gap: None (Module included but deactivated per musical verdict).

blocks.purpose: Add subtle depth and weight to the heavy riffs without sounding modern or clean.
blocks.gap: Delay is kept minimal (low feedback/level) so it enhances the riff weight rather than defining a melodic line.

blocks.purpose: Provide a sense of space and weight without adding excessive shimmer or brightness.
blocks.gap: Room reverb is preferred over Plate/Spring to maintain the dark, earthy feel of classic heavy rock.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism to enhance the weight and darkness of the Sabbath tone.

proposals.reason: Enhance dark, woolly weight and vintage character.
